title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - FA-8901
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: FA-8901 (REFLUX ACCUMULATOR DRUM).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-8901, Title: P&ID: REFLUX ACCUMULATOR DRUM (FA-8901).
Area: 8900 – Solvent Fractionation, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-8900-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- LSHH-8901: Drum level HIGH-HIGH (Level Switch) [Setpoint: > 85 %]. Function: Cause T1 (Trip Column Feed). Location: Drum FA-8901 Level Bridle. Interlock: T1/EFF-1/EFF-4
- LSLL-8901: Drum level LOW-LOW (Level Switch) [Setpoint: < 15 %]. Function: Cause T2 (Trip Reflux Pump GA-8920). Location: Drum FA-8901 Level Bridle. Interlock: T2/EFF-2/EFF-4
- PSHH-8902: Drum pressure HIGH-HIGH (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: > 8 barg]. Function: Cause T3 (Open Vent PCV-8905). Location: Drum FA-8901. Interlock: T3/EFF-3/EFF-4
- HS-8901: Manual Emergency Stop (Hand Switch) [Setpoint: Manual —]. Function: Cause T4 (Manual E-Stop). Location: Local Control Station. Interlock: T4/EFF-1/EFF-2/EFF-3/EFF-4
- LT-8901: Level Transmitter (Level Transmitter) [Setpoint: 20-80 %]. Function: Permissive P1 (Level in normal band) & Control. Location: Drum FA-8901 Level Bridle. Interlock: P1
- PT-8902: Pressure Transmitter (Pressure Transmitter). Function: Permissive P2 (N2 blanket healthy) & Control. Location: Drum FA-8901. Interlock: P2
- LT-8903: Boot Interface Level (Level Transmitter). Function: Permissive P3 (Boot not flooded) & Control. Location: Drum FA-8901 Water Boot. Interlock: P3
- PCV-8905: N2 Blanketing Split-Range Valve (Control Valve). Function: Nitrogen blanketing & Venting. Location: N2 Blanket / Vent Header. Interlock: EFF-3
- PSV-8901: Pressure Safety Valve (Relief Valve) [Setpoint: 10 barg]. Function: Overpressure protection (Car-sealed open). Location: Drum FA-8901 Top Nozzle. Interlock: —
- HV-8904: Boot Drain Valve (Hand Valve). Function: Manual boot draining. Location: Water Boot Drain Line. Interlock: —
- GA-8920 A/B: Reflux Pump A/B (Duty/Standby) (Centrifugal Pump). Function: Memompa refluks ke kolom DA-8910. Location: Pump Skid. Interlock: EFF-2
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-FA-8901, Interlock: SEQ-8901 (SIL 1).
